name: Monitor
description: Android apps for a wall-mounted tablet: live video from IP cameras over RTSP/ONVIF, a custom wrapper library around VLC, native libraries for smooth playback, and support for Hikvision and Dahua cameras.

name: Mobile app security testing
description: Pentested a production social app: intercepted its traffic, de-obfuscated the client and reviewed its certificate pinning. Now training with HexTree in Frida instrumentation, network interception and reverse engineering.

name: Cashbook by Khatabook
description: A bookkeeping app for small businesses. Analytics, A/B tests and feature flags for the product team; features such as a GST calculator, full-text search and payment reminders; localization and release management.

name: Daif
description: Co-led the Android client of Daif, a crowd-management platform used during Hajj to schedule and track buses in real time.
